decisions.reason: The area elastic sports floor extends an established sports-flooring competence, and with industry turnover growing and no sign of a shortfall against aspirations, there is little pressure to search for other uses of its resources.
The mobile arena floor line builds on existing production and technical service, and steady results with available slack make keeping it the satisficing choice, though it overlaps with Product C.
As a second mobile arena system it carries some risk of being merged into Product B, but without evidence of underperformance the firm is likely to keep it in the sports range.
The chevron parquet line is the flagship of the firm's trend-led residential direction and fits its core aspirations, so dropping it is very unlikely.
A squash court finish is a low-cost niche complement to the sports floors that uses existing surface know-how, so there is no performance gap that would trigger removing it.
Oak skirting for sports floors is a cheap accessory that supports system sales and ties up few resources, so the firm will carry it.
